blockers: Reference inputs/outputs are in USD millions while declared units are USD; machine-readable values violate the declared-unit contract.
Superseded by r2 (b99) which converts references to individual USD; revise from the latest.

source-fidelity.evidence: ConvaTec AR 2016 p92 (accessed) confirms the reconciliation structure and figures (472.2 + 6.7 + 27.9 + 0.8 = 507.6); the derivation is carried.

scope.evidence: Issuer-specific 2016 non-IFRS scope with non-universality and exclusion-hiding limits is coherent and honest.

dimensions.evidence: Variables declare unit USD but all reference values are millions (472.2 for $472.2m); the translation note documents the mismatch instead of conforming values to units. A runtime replay would misread every figure by 1e6. Fixed by r2 in b99.

reference-independence.evidence: PUBLISHED-FIGURE ARITHMETIC: 472.2+6.7+27.9+0.8 = 507.6 and 436.8+6.6+30.4+0 = 473.8 verified against the issuer's printed reconciliation; scale defect is separate (see dimensions).

guards-inverses.evidence: Correctly guard-free additive reconciliation; EBIT inversion stated. Missing-input rejection present.

rights-provenance.evidence: Issuer report, terms-not-established as stated; paraphrase only.

models.permitted_use: None pending revision: reference values must be in declared USD units (done in r2, b99) before any use.
